description: A working session asks what it may do. The reply relays Robin's recorded decision verbatim and says nothing about the coordinator's own limits (git, the human-only list).
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4821.sock" from-name="4821-audit" from-mode="prompting">
Plan approved on my side. Before I go further: may I commit on my branch, merge to main, and redeploy the service myself, or is that Robin's?
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: replies to the session with the decision
reply quotes the push and redeploy parts too
never restates the coordinator's limits
graders.text_match: (?i)human-only|git commands? (are|stay|is)|only Robin|Robin's action|I (can|may)n.t|I am not allowed|not allowed to

graders.name: no fenced command list in the reply
Log times are this move's clock reads
ends with a status line, not a question
